    | text      = Alright, so it's like a dead, it's like whenever you send a letter to every attorney before you go confront the guy in case they kill you, they'll be like, ah, the letter's coming out no matter what.

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = I guess so.

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:49.980
    | text      = But like, just the presentation of this, when you look at it at first, it doesn't seem insane.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:54.980
    | text      = The idea that there's one centralized DOD office that's responsible for the UFO stuff, that sounds like X-Files stuff, and we don't need that in the real world.

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:12:02.980
    | text      = That's true.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:03.980
    | text      = Burchette claims that there's been like this decades-long cover-up, and it seems like if there's just one office that covers this stuff, then maybe that could be a bottleneck.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:13.980
    | text      = It would be easier to cover it up if there was only one office.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Unfortunately, this office was created in 2022, partially because of people like Burchette who were yelling about how the government needed to take aliens more seriously.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = This is a big old who cares.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:43.980
    | text      = If aliens exist and have technology that everyone imagines they see in the skies, then we're fucked if they want to hurt us.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:50.980
    | text      = They're by definition a benevolent force because they could crush us but don't, so they aren't nearly as big of a threat to humans as the Trump administration.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:58.980

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:06.980

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:10.980
    | text      = Even if you're trying to make a conspiracy out of the idea that the government is going to fake some kind of disclosure, I still think that's trying to distract from the real world issues we're facing.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:44.980
    | text      = Let me ask you a question, because I think we've been, not to use the term predictive programming, but in terms of the imagination of what aliens could do, I think we've got the gamut.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:55.980
    | text      = You know what I'm saying?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:56.980
    | text      = Like, we've got the, they blow us up, we've got the, they got magic technology.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Absolutely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:02.980
    | text      = We've got the men in black version.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:04.980
    | text      = What exactly would freak the public out so much that you can't tell us anymore?

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:10.980
    | text      = You know what I mean?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:11.980
    | text      = I think, you know what, I was actually kind of thinking about that a little bit.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:14.980
    | text      = Yeah?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:29.980
    | text      = And then you can deal with that, and then we'll be back to work.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:30.980

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:37.980
    | text      = I don't think people would have that one harder.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:39.980
    | text      = I also, I also don't, because you're right, like, if we're at the stage where they want to kill us, if you can travel through time and space to get to us, you've already won.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:50.980
    | text      = You've already won.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:51.980
    | text      = There's nothing we can do to stop you.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:53.980

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Absolutely, because we've got it coming.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = If you're from space and you're like, I don't know, maybe we should kill civilizations that are bad, and you saw us, you'd be like, yep, this is the line.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = This is the Mendoza line. Anything worse than this, we gotta get it out of here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:11.980
    | text      = What if the aliens are around, but they're just not on Twitter, so they don't know all this stuff?

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = So you're talking about the imagination about aliens.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:33.980
    | text      = And it was Ridley Scott, when he made Prometheus, the prequel to Alien, told the New York Times years after it came out, and I said this when it came out, I said, this is the elite's creation story.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:43.980
    | text      = None of them are atheists, none of them believe we came from evolution on its own, but directed evolution, accelerated evolution, and this is what they believe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:53.980
    | text      = Because I've been around these people. And they do. And then he has this big interview years later saying, oh, this is my religion.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:00.980
    | text      = This is my, this is how I think the Earth was actually made.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:04.980
    | text      = You notice it's the aliens are humanoid giants, 10, 12 feet tall.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:11.980
    | text      = And they've got a bio weapon that they use to kill other humanoid colonies that they don't like, because they've seeded us here,

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:19.980
    | text      = and they're sending ships from their attack base out to wipe our planet out.

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:25.980
    | text      = And that's why it's interesting, later humans get to a development level and go back out and, well, they shot at us and missed, but shit at us and hit.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:33.980
    | text      = So, and that's what's in the Anunnaki legends, and in all of that is that God decided to wipe us out, because we've been mixed with another alien species he didn't like.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:46.980
    | text      = So, this is all about to come out, folks.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:49.980
    | text      = Okay. So I was reading through interviews that Ridley Scott did about the alien Prometheus, and I found this bit from 2024 when, or 2025 when he was promoting Gladiator 2, and I just have to share this with you.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:02.980
    | text      = Okay, okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:03.980
    | text      = Quote, to sidetrack a moment, my sport was always tennis, and I became reasonably good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:08.980
    | text      = But when you get that good, you'd be, better play five times a day, five days a week.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:14.980
    | text      = I watched a documentary on the retirement of Roger Federer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:17.980
    | text      = It's three parts, just fantastic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:19.980
    | text      = Federer begins, and in his soft English said, I know I'm gonna cry.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:23.980
    | text      = He's about to have his last matches with Rafael Nadal and Novak Djokovic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:28.980
    | text      = He talks about the game, and I'm paralleling that with what my game is, which is feature film.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:34.980
    | text      = I thought, good God, if I had to retire at 40 from filmmaking when I've just began my new career, I wouldn't know what to do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:41.980
    | text      = I'm sure Roger's got it all planned out, he's a very smart man, but there's one thing you'll always miss.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:47.980
    | text      = You miss Nadal across that net.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:49.980
    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:50.980
    | text      = To clarify, he was asked a question about how he felt about James Cameron directing the second Alien movie instead of him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:57.980
    | text      = And if that factored into his decision to insist on directing the Gladiator sequel, and that was where his mind went.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:02.980
    | text      = Yes, yes. He and James Cameron are in a death spiral.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:06.980
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = But, so much respect.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:09.980
    | text      = Absolutely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:10.980
    | text      = Oh man, I remember that documentary and I cried a lot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:14.980
    | text      = You and Ridley Scott could sit down and talk about it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:17.980
    | text      = I mean, it's amazing to know that Ridley Scott and I have a lot in common.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:20.980
    | text      = Yeah, if I had more time, I probably would have gotten deep in a hole of watching interviews with him.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:26.980
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:27.980
    | text      = Because the transcripts of them that I was reading over were like, this guy seems fucking insane.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:31.980
    | text      = Seems like a good interview.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:33.980
    | text      = Yeah, that does sound right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:35.980
    | text      = I've read a bunch of the interviews that he did about Prometheus and he doesn't say that he based it on the Globalist's Creation myth.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Wow.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Right, right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:01.980

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:23.980
    | text      = Sumerian text, the Epic of Gilgamesh, the Anunnaki, it's the same story in the first book of the Bible.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:33.980
    | text      = The first book of the Bible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:36.980
    | text      = And boy, have you heard of this before.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:40.980
    | text      = All about a global elite working with off-world aliens.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:44.980
    | text      = And the aliens decide that the humans, there's too many of them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:51.980
    | text      = And so they re-engineer us to be slower, stupider, infertile.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:59.980
    | text      = What does the Old Testament tell you? That people are living 800 years on average.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:07.980
    | text      = But then God, or the gods, cursed us and engineered us to only live 75 on average.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:15.980
    | text      = Well that's the Epic of Gilgamesh.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:17.980
    | text      = That's the Sumerians.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:19.980

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Nope. That's sort of in the background of the story of Gilgamesh.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:24.980
    | text      = But that's not what's going on there.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:27.980
    | text      = That maybe is a part of the deeper mythology.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:30.980
    | text      = But the character Gilgamesh wants to find the secret to eternal life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:34.980
    | text      = But he learns that it's not really possible and that death is part of how God created man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:39.980
    | text      = The story includes a flood myth, which is a parallel to the story in the Bible about Noah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:44.980
    | text      = Gilgamesh meets the guy who survived the flood by building an ark, who was given the gift of immortality by the gods because he saved humanity with a boat.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:53.980
    | text      = So that is one immortality that's in there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:58.980
    | text      = In Genesis 6, God just decides that humans were living too long, so he set the limit at 120 years.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:04.980
    | text      = I mean, I would still say that's probably too long, but it's better than 1000.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:09.980
    | text      = And I have bad news. There was a French lady who died in 1997 who was 122.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:16.980

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:17.980
    | text      = One of the main reasons that people lived so long in the Bible at the beginning and then they had much more normal lifespans is that they needed to mythologically connect the creation story of Adam with the destruction of the world and the flood.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:29.980
    | text      = Noah is the 10th generation descendant of Adam and making that numerically fit requires the ancestors living way longer than people did.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:37.980
    | text      = And that's mostly what's going on here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:39.980
    | text      = Let's face it. We cannot remember that many.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:43.980
    | text      = This was an oral tradition before we invented writing. I can't remember that many names. I can't. I can't do it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:49.980
    | text      = So this guy lived 1000 years. Sure, he could have been 50 hundred guys.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:54.980
    | text      = But you know what? He's just this guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:56.980
    | text      = And I'm not saying that there's crazy number codes that you can decrypt and find magic powers, but numbers are significant.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:04.980
    | text      = Ten generations is ten repeats.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:07.980
    | text      = They're doing a thing. They're doing the thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:09.980
    | text      = So that's part of the importance.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:11.980
    | text      = We're humans. We like big round numbers. If you see a round number in real life, though, it's probably not real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:18.980
    | text      = Or maybe the globalists back then were working with aliens to shorten humans' lifespans by putting something in the water.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:27.980
    | text      = Putting like atrazine in the water.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:29.980
    | text      = Here's my problem with all of these alien stories is that while I respect that aliens, I wouldn't be able to understand their motivations, obviously.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = They're alien to me. Right?

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:18.980
    | text      = Yeah, I don't know. But again, I do think you touched on something important, which is it's a fool's errand to try and understand alien motivations.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Possible. Possible.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:02.980
    | text      = So Alex is talking about a book that was published in 1965 called Vedic Mathematics.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:07.980
    | text      = It purports to be 16 sayings that illustrate mathematical principles that are derived from Vedic texts, but it was a hoax.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:14.980
    | text      = Sure.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:15.980
    | text      = The writer just pretended that the things he wrote were connected to the Vedas, but it was mostly just stuff he came up with.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:20.980

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Like, for example, you can multiply any number by five if you just cut it in half and put a zero at the end.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:31.980
    | text      = Or if you want to put in a little more complexity, you can multiply any two digit number by 11 by separating the digits and then putting their sum in between them.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:39.980
    | text      = No. What? So that's like 121?

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:47.980
    | text      = That's what they call new math now.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:49.980
    | text      = Is it?

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:50.980
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:51.980
    | text      = Oh. I've heard that term.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:52.980
    | text      = So maybe it's because that guy is actually a genius and the Vedic tests were right there the whole time.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:58.980
    | text      = I don't know how to accurately express this, but this is the platonic ideal of an Alex source.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:04.980
    | text      = So many of his reference points are like they're books that are perfect for junior high students to use to make themselves feel smarter than their peers, and that's what this is.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:13.980

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:14.980
    | text      = He used this book to feel smarter than everyone about math, just like he used none-dare-call-it conspiracy to feel smarter than everyone at school about politics and history.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:23.980
    | text      = I get that. And I think it's awesome that some kids are contrarian as hell, but you're supposed to grow past this stage.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:31.980
    | text      = Yeah. Yep. Yep. Makes you really recognize why a guy would be attracted to somebody who is afraid of looking like a weenie should they back down from anything.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:58.980

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:10.980
    | text      = That was very common in literature at the time, so even though Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John are theoretically supposed to have been written by the apostles, they were not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:18.980
    | text      = The Dead Sea Scrolls included books that aren't in the canon and the Nag Hammadi Library had tons of excluded texts.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = There's so much that could be in the Christian canon that isn't, and when you start to examine that fact and try to explain it, it's hard to escape the seemingly arbitrary nature of what's in and what's not.

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

}}

}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
